sample_unit: medical staff testers in the emergency department
unlisted_practices: Grounding a free LLM tool (NotebookLM) on curated clinical guidelines to build a no-code clinical decision-support aid
Expert rating of AI response accuracy and completeness with interrater reliability
Staff questionnaire on consultation time savings and medical literacy after ED deployment

screen.reason: The study evaluates an expert decision-support system built with Google NotebookLM (Gemini 2.0) grounded on clinical guidelines and deployed among emergency department medical staff, assessing response accuracy, clinical literacy, and consultation time.
